name: html-split-rule-table-cell-feature-shell-reserves-width
description: An empty `display:table-cell` whose class names a platform feature (`cart`) is authored layout when its cascaded declarations give it a width, even when `display` and `width` come from separate rules. The Weebly header shape (`.nav{display:table-cell}` + `.membership-cart{width:25%}` around an empty login slot) and a same-class two-rule cell (`.cart{display:table-cell}.cart{width:25%}`) both survive as empty groups carrying their source classes, so the logo and menu keep their 25%/50% columns. An unstyled empty search shell is still dropped as dead chrome.

source_reference.notes: Reduction of issue #6798 (Weebly 'unite' header), following #6748 and #6781.

legacy_comparison.reason: This upstream primitive fixture has no downstream legacy comparison.
